description: Check text BEFORE your agent sends it to an LLM, tool, log or webhook: finds crypto wallet keys (BIP39 seed phrases with checksum, EVM/Solana private keys, WIF, xprv), API secrets (GitHub, AWS, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, Telegram, npm, JWT, PEM) and PII (cards, IBAN, SSN, email, phone). Free preview tier: verdict, safe_to_send and counts by type (text up to 8192 bytes). Redacted text: paid x402 endpoint /v1/lite ($0.005); JSON payloads and live balances of wallets whose keys leaked: /v1/scan ($0.02).

text.description: Text to check before it is sent (prompt, tool arguments, log, message, file content). POST /v1/scan also accepts {"json": <any JSON payload>}.

name: scan_for_leaks
title: Check text for leaked secrets before sending it
